messages.text:
Good afternoon,

I am writing to request a status update on my recent order, as I am unable
to locate the tracking status on your website.

Order Number: Shop····
Product: Harlo B30

Could you please confirm if this order has shipped and provide an estimated
delivery date? Please let me know the next steps.

Thank you,
Kevin P.
Note to the team: I'll look up the order first.

Hi Kevin,

Thanks for writing in, and happy to clear this up.

Order Shop···· is paid and has not shipped yet. Nothing is wrong with it, your Harlo B30 is a pre-order unit, built and allocated to you, and it ships November 30, 2026. The Harlo OS Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA goes out with it in the same order, so there is one shipment, not two. That is why there is no tracking to see yet.

As soon as it leaves our warehouse you will get the tracking number by email automatically, to this address, and the carrier estimate for delivery comes with it. Worth adding (email hidden) to your contacts so it does not land in junk.

In the meantime you can follow the incoming B30 batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Nothing is needed from you. If anything changes on the date, we will write to you first.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Kevin,

Before you wait on anything, let me just give you the answer now.

Order Shop···· is paid and has not shipped yet. Your Harlo B30 is a pre-order unit, built and allocated to you, and it ships November 30, 2026. The Harlo OS Diagnostics and 3-Month RMA on the order goes out in the same box, so it is one shipment. That is why there is no tracking showing yet.

When it leaves the warehouse, the tracking number comes to this address automatically, with the carrier's delivery estimate. Worth adding (email hidden) to your contacts so it does not land in junk.

You can follow the incoming B30 batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Nothing is needed from you, and if the date ever moves, we write to you first.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
